title: Wendell and the Garden
author: Emrys Halloran
blurb: Hazel Coldharbour, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
